HediffDef.label: vivi fairy
HediffDef.description: The souls of 1,440,000,000 vivis, forcibly fairyfied and bound to the last queen of the ancient empire, are wrapped around Apocrypha like armor. The bound fairies weave a mana shield around her that takes every blow in her place. Once the shield shatters, she is stunned for a long time and scatters doom bloom seeds (and a fairy bloom seed) in her convulsions; the shield is restored when she recovers. \nA vivi carrying the interference of a fairy bloom can draw close and cause a mana backflow in this bond network, releasing a vast number of fairies at once.

HediffDef.label: primordial carapace
HediffDef.description: Freed from the weight of billions of souls, the progenitor hornet is sheathed in a carapace condensed over centuries, and three giant eltex needles circle her, striking on their own. \nA needle that fires while Apocrypha stands in its path pierces her instead and stays lodged in her carapace. Each lodged needle increases the damage she takes (+50%, +100%, +300%). Once all three are lodged she is stunned for a long time, and when she recovers she tears the needles out. \nThe resonance wave of an everflower attunement ritual still stuns her.
